name: Unity
oneLiner: UTY is XSY's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: USDC deposits hedged by long AVAX spot and short perps, with a 7-day redemption unbonding.
collateral: USDC deposits hedged via delta-neutral pairing of long AVAX spot positions with short perpetual futures; yield generated from perpetual contract funding rates; custody via Ceffu & Copper Clearloop
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint UTY at 1:1; XSY maintains peg by delta-neutral hedging with long AVAX spot and short perpetual futures positions; users redeem UTY back to USDC after a 7-day unbonding period

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: UTY is XSY's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: users mint UTY 1:1 from USDC and the XSY operator deploys the backing into long AVAX spot + short perps under Ceffu/Copper Clearloop custody, redeeming after a 7-day unbonding; mint/redeem is operator-run, not a user-collateralized CDP.

controls.label: XSY issuance/minter backend (USDC -> UTY)
controls.evidence: XSY docs/site describe minting UTY by swapping in USDC, with the operator running the delta-neutral hedge (long AVAX spot, short perps) and a 7-day unbonding to redeem back to USDC; this is an operator-gated synthetic mint, not a user-opened CDP.

controls.label: Ceffu & Copper Clearloop custody / hedging venues
controls.evidence: XSY materials state backing is held via Ceffu and Copper Clearloop custody and hedged on CEX/perp venues; custody is centralized off the mint chain and Accountable provides real-time reserve attestation.

review.evidence: XSY documentation and launch coverage describe UTY as an operator-run delta-neutral synthetic dollar: USDC mint, CEX/perp hedging under Ceffu/Copper custody, and a 7-day redemption unbonding, with Accountable real-time PoR. This is a synthetic/operator-minted model, not the proposed user-collateralized CDP. On-chain minter admin not independently confirmed.
